Hi agent! If you need to work with the horsies Rust crate, consider using the docs locally.

# Horsies (Rust)
> The Rust client of the horsies core: a PostgreSQL-backed background task queue and workflow engine.
> Docs: https://suleymanozkeskin.github.io/horsies/rust/
> Source: https://github.com/suleymanozkeskin/horsies/tree/main/clients/rust/horsies
> Crates: horsies, horsies-macros, horsies-core, horsies-core-derive

The Python client and the Rust client run on one core (horsies-core). Behaviour and guarantees are on the shared pages, for both clients. The Rust pages state the API of the crate. A database belongs to one client: the core refuses a database that the Python client installed.

## Rust API pages
- Overview -> /horsies/rust/
- Getting Started -- cargo add horsies; one binary is the producer, the worker and each child; build_app, a worker profile with the default preload (ChildPreload::NoPreload), main hands the command line to horsies::cli::run; worker --profile default; send and read a result -> /horsies/rust/quick-start/getting-started/
- App Config -- Horsies::new, with_schema_mode (MigrateAndValidate, ObserveOnly, AssumeInitialized), with_handle, AppConfig fields, Rust-only refusals (pool size bounds, preload), queues, register, provide, discover, workflow_builder, registrations per app (two apps in one process share none), AppRole, suppress_sends / HORSIES_SUPPRESS_SENDS -> /horsies/rust/configuration/app-config/
- Defining Tasks -- #[horsies::task], #[horsies::blocking_task], execution = isolated | shared_async | shared_thread, timeout_ms, cancel_grace_ms, retry_policy + auto_retry_for, the generated module (register, send(&app, ...), with_options, node, handle; no process-wide state), TaskRuntime (state, cancelled, is_cancelled, cancel_state, spawn, task_handle, workflow_builder, fencing_token -> FencingToken | FencingTokenRefused), RunCancelState, CancelCause (the cancel signal at an operator cancel and at the deadline; cancel_grace_ms on isolated: the kill after an operator cancel), async_task_fn!, blocking_task_fn! -> /horsies/rust/tasks/defining-tasks/
- Task Errors -- TaskError<E>, TaskErrorCode<E> (Library, User), #[derive(horsies::UserErrorCode)], with_data (never fails; data_refused), ExceptionRecord, SubWorkflowFailure, WORKER_SERIALIZATION_ERROR for input and return read-back -> /horsies/rust/tasks/errors/
- Sending Tasks -- TaskFunction<A, T, E>: send, send_with_options, with_options; the generated task_name::send(&app, ...) and task_name::with_options(options).send(&app, ...) (VALIDATION_FAILED through an app that does not register the task); TaskSendOptions (delay(WholeSeconds), good_until, idempotency_key, retention, retain_forever); SendRetention; TaskSendError catalog; retry_send (a delayed send keeps its delay); resend_on_transient_err; PayloadPolicy -> /horsies/rust/tasks/sending-tasks/
- Retrieving Results -- TaskHandle::get(WaitLimit) -> Result<TaskOutcome<T, E>, ReadError>; kept reads; info(TaskInfoParts); app.task_handle_of, get_result, get_raw_result (StoredResult), get_task_info -> /horsies/rust/tasks/retrieving-results/
- Blocking API -- horsies::blocking: task_function.blocking() (TaskFunctionView, TaskFunctionSendOptionsView), handle.blocking() (TaskHandleView), app.blocking() (HorsiesView), workflow_function.blocking() (WorkflowFunctionView), workflow_template.blocking() (WorkflowTemplateView), workflow_handle.blocking() (WorkflowHandleView), app.blocking().start_workflow::<D>(), app.blocking().start_workflow_with::<D>(params); ASYNC_CONTEXT on a runtime thread (TaskSendError::AsyncContext, ReadError::AsyncContext, BrokerErrorCode::AsyncContext, HRS-217, WorkflowStartErrorCode::AsyncContext, HandleErrorCode::AsyncContext, WorkflowReadError::AsyncContext); the order of the checks -> /horsies/rust/tasks/blocking-api/
- Workflow API -- WorkflowDefinition (Output, Parameters, name, definition_key, on_error, define, build(builder), build_with(builder, params)), WorkflowDefinitionConfig, app.workflow_builder(name), TaskRuntime::workflow_builder, WorkflowSpecBuilder (task returns Result: HRS-302 for a task that the builder's app does not register), WorkflowSpec, register_workflow_definition, register_workflow_definition_with, WorkflowFunction, WorkflowTemplate, app.start_workflow::<D>(), app.start_workflow_with::<D>(params) (VALIDATION_FAILED when the app does not register D), app.start, TaskRuntime::start, WorkflowStartError, WorkflowHandle (get, result_for, status, results, nodes, cancel, pause, resume), WorkflowReadError, HandleOperationError, OutputlessResults, SuccessPolicy, check_workflow_builder (the builder function gets a builder of the app and the case) -> /horsies/rust/concepts/workflows/workflow-api/
- Typed Node Builder -- task_name::node() (no registration read; builder.task resolves it against the builder's app), task_name::params::<name>(), TaskNode<T, I> (set, set_input, input_json, arg_from, waits_for, workflow_ctx_from, node_id, queue, priority, allow_failed_deps, join_all, join_any, join_quorum, good_until), TaskOutcome<S, E> parameters, WorkflowContext, WorkflowContextError, TypedNodeRef, NodeRef, NodeKey, InputField -> /horsies/rust/concepts/workflows/typed-node-builder/
- Subworkflows -- build_with, #[derive(WorkflowInput)] field tokens, SubWorkflowParameters (NotGiven, Given), SubWorkflowNode, a child built from a dependency's result, SubWorkflowSummary, SubWorkflowFailure, nesting limit 32 (HRS-036, HRS-037) -> /horsies/rust/concepts/workflows/subworkflows/
- Crash-Safe Multi-Step Work -- one workflow node per step with effects, so a retry or a worker crash runs only the failed step; retry_policy and auto_retry_for per step, arg_from with TaskOutcome, WorkflowTemplate, what runs again, when one task fits better, idempotency keys for external effects -> /horsies/rust/guides/crash-safe-multi-step-work/
- Worker Setup -- WorkerProfile (isolated, shared_async, shared_thread, pool, claim, drain_timeout, preload (default ChildPreload::NoPreload, the only value a Rust worker takes), parent_cpu), IsolatedChildren, SharedAsyncChildren, SharedThreadChildren, IsolatedRecycle, SharedRecycle, pools, ClaimLimits, DrainTimeout, bounded counts (try_from, from_constant, OutOfBounds), on_child_start (CHILD_START_HOOK_BOUND), WorkerStart, run_worker, WorkerRunError -> /horsies/rust/workers/worker-setup/
- Schedule Config -- AppConfig.schedule: ScheduleConfig (enabled, schedules, check_interval_seconds), TaskSchedule (input, queue, timezone, catch_up_missed, max_catch_up_runs), SchedulePattern (Interval, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Cron), CronSchedule, CronNumericTerm, CronEnumTerm, DaySelector, schedule checks (HRS-205, HRS-300), scheduler(), PreparedScheduler, run_scheduler, SchedulerRunError -> /horsies/rust/scheduling/schedule-config/
- Health Reads -- ping_database, ping_workers(PingTarget, timeout, min_responses), list_worker_states, get_worker_state, get_worker_state_history(WorkerHistoryLimit), get_stale_tasks(StaleMinutes), get_expired_tasks, BoundedTaskList (Complete, Truncated; TASK_LIST_BOUND 10,000), get_class_coverage, get_class_report -> /horsies/rust/monitoring/health-reads/
- Monitoring Queries -- horsies::monitoring: task_stats, task_facets, task_breakdown, list_tasks, get_task_detail, list_workflow_names, list_workflow_runs, get_workflow_run (phase timing: RunTimingInfo, NodeTimingInfo, segments, coverage labels), get_workflow_node, list_schedules; AttemptPhasesInfo on each attempt; TaskStatsQuery, TaskFacetsQuery, TaskBreakdownQuery, TaskListQuery, WorkflowRunsQuery, TaskFilters, PaginationRefused, resolve_monitoring_window (24 h default, 30 days max), MonitoringQueryError; cancel_task (a RUNNING task with include_running: the attempt is recorded as Cancelled, and the task code gets the cancel), TaskActionError; cancel_task_action, pause_workflow_action, resume_workflow_action, cancel_workflow_action, ActionOutcome -> /horsies/rust/monitoring/monitoring-queries/
- Tracing Setup -- feature otel; the global providers and propagator of opentelemetry 0.33 set first in main; horsies::otel::layer(); ATTEMPT_SPAN_TARGET; shut the provider down after run; producer metrics -> /horsies/rust/observability/tracing-setup/
- Web UI Mount -- feature web; horsies::web::router(&app, MonitoringConfig, policy) -> axum::Router; MonitoringConfig (ui: MonitoringUiConfig, actions: Actions); MonitoringAuthPolicy (can_view, can_act), MonitoringRequest; AllowAll, ViewOnly, TrustedHeader; X-Horsies-Intent: action -> /horsies/rust/monitoring/web-ui-mount/
- Event Handlers -- horsies::events: the event types (TaskClaimed, ClaimReleased, AttemptPlaced, AttemptNotStarted, AttemptEnded, AttemptRecorded, TaskRecovered, ChildStarted, ChildReplaced, SlotDown, SlotRecovered), app.on_event::<E>(name, async handler), app.on_event_blocking::<E>(name, handler), HandlerError, on_handler_child_start; the handler child, a thread and a queue of HANDLER_QUEUE_EVENTS per handler, drops and failures counted (horsies.telemetry.handler.dropped, horsies.telemetry.handler.errors), HANDLER_STATS_INTERVAL, HANDLER_DRAIN -> /horsies/rust/monitoring/event-handlers/
- Rerun in Your Transaction -- horsies::rerun: app.rerun_task (AppRerunError), rerun_task_in on the caller's transaction (CallerRerunError), SqlxCaller (feature sqlx), TokioPostgresCaller (feature tokio-postgres), CallerTransaction, RerunTask, RerunEnqueuePolicy (new, standard), RerunOutcome -> /horsies/rust/operations/rerun-in-your-transaction/
- Async Frameworks -- a tokio web service (axum): build the app once, the async forms in handlers, TaskFunction in router state, task_name::send(&app, ...), the service apart from the worker's child mode, ASYNC_CONTEXT -> /horsies/rust/guides/async-frameworks/
- Testing -- direct calls of task functions, app.task_runtime(), TaskOutcome parameters, a WorkflowContext from its stored form, the generated Input, app.check() with no database, suppress_sends and HORSIES_SUPPRESS_SENDS -> /horsies/rust/operations/testing/
- CLI Reference -- horsies::cli::run(app) in the app's fn main; <binary> worker --profile <name> [--metrics-listen HOST:PORT], scheduler, check [--live], metrics --listen HOST:PORT (the fleet metrics at GET /metrics); --loglevel, RUST_LOG; run_with_log_format(app, LogFormat::Json); child mode (--horsies-child); removed 0.1.0-alpha flags exit 2; exit codes 0, 1, 2, 77 and the ChildHostExit codes -> /horsies/rust/cli/
- Switching to 0.8.0 -- for horsies-rust 0.1.0-alpha apps: the core refuses an alpha database (ForeignMigrations), drain it and start 0.8.0 on a new database; the API changes: app, binary and CLI, tasks and errors, sends and reads, workflows, monitoring, rerun, stored forms -> /horsies/rust/migrations/switching-to-0-8-0/
